name: ASCII Emoji
description:
Search and copy Unicode Kaomoji and ASCII emojis straight from your top panel, like (◉‿◉)

Features:
• Hundreds of Kaomoji and ASCII emojis, searchable by name or keyword
• One click copies the emoji to the clipboard
• Your most-used emojis move to the top, and are remembered across updates
• Lightweight panel indicator

The emoji list is compiled from asciimoji.com. Source code, release notes and bug reports are on GitHub.
